lines.sub: Hi! This is “AI Academy”, lesson six — “Mailing”.
lines.tts: Hi! This is AI Academy, lesson six — Mailing.

lines.sub: A hundred clients — a hundred emails by hand? Or one for everyone — and everyone sees the others' addresses.
lines.tts: A hundred clients — a hundred emails by hand? Or one for everyone — and everyone sees the others' addresses.

lines.sub: Say: “Send to all clients: from Monday we're open until eight.”
lines.tts: Say: Send to all clients: from Monday we're open until eight.

lines.sub: Everyone gets their own email — with their own name. Nobody sees anyone else's address.
lines.tts: Everyone gets their own email — with their own name. Nobody sees anyone else's address.

lines.sub: To whom — clients, only those with a tag, employees or your own list.
lines.tts: To whom — clients, only those with a tag, employees or your own list.

lines.sub: Emails go out one by one. Mail services allow about three hundred a day — the rest go out tomorrow on their own.
lines.tts: Emails go out one by one. Mail services allow about three hundred a day — the rest go out tomorrow on their own.

lines.sub: Ads — only to those who agreed. Replied “Unsubscribe” — I don't write again.
lines.tts: Ads — only to those who agreed. Replied Unsubscribe — I don't write again.

lines.sub: A hundred out of a hundred. I'll send the summary myself.
lines.tts: A hundred out of a hundred. I'll send the summary myself.
